authorization_boundary: Experiment 0015 is unregistered. No Alpha 015 return archive, strategy PnL, development result, or locked-validation result has been acquired or inspected. This stricter alignment is recorded before any return-data authorization.

policy_binding.primary_objective: Validate positive long-horizon cost-after expectancy while preserving capital; a monthly return target is not a pass/fail gate.

candidate_compatibility.reason: The fixed equal-weight top-quintile and bottom-quintile construction requires six long and six short USD-M futures positions at the minimum 30-instrument universe. A cross-sectional basket is not one futures position for the two-position risk limit.
candidate_compatibility.required_action: Do not preregister or acquire Alpha 015 return data under the current policy. A materially different, separately screened and preregistered two-position hypothesis is required before research can resume.

supersedes_for_this_unregistered_candida: The 15 percent development and locked-validation minute MTM drawdown acceptance threshold in the template and risk amendment 010.
The post-validation portfolio-level 10 percent monthly-return target gate.
replacement: Development and locked validation would require base and stress minute MTM drawdown at or below 10 percent if a future eligible two-position successor is registered.
Long-horizon positive cost-after expectancy is required; a monthly return number is not a pass/fail gate.
The present Alpha 015 template is vetoed before data acquisition because its required concurrent futures positions exceed the policy limit.
nonchanges: The candidate remains deferred and Experiment 0015 remains unregistered.
The 180 consecutive prior-day point-in-time universe requirement, 120/60 split, causal model, timing, costs, funding accounting, source integrity, and locked-validation boundary remain unchanged.
No observed return, cost, or performance result is selected, discarded, or interpreted by this amendment.
prohibited: acquiring or inspecting returns before activation and preregistration
weakening the 10 percent risk limit after observing returns
using any historical result to authorize live trading
